definition: Six experimental bond lengths for compound 1 from SI Table S2 (printed S10-S11). Parenthesized (1) is the reported crystallographic estimated standard deviation, 0.001 angstrom for each bond; it is not merely decimal rounding. These are experimental inputs, not calculated reference answers.
uncertainty: Marginal crystallographic standard uncertainties are provided for all six bonds. Their covariance matrix is not supplied here. Decimal rounding of the central values (up to0.0005 angstrom) is separate from these standard uncertainties; do not substitute rounding intervals for ESDs or assert a confidence interval without covariance/distribution assumptions.
